# coolify_resource_action (Resource)

Triggers a `start`, `stop` or `restart` on an application, database or service. The action runs on create and again whenever `triggers` changes (replacement re-runs it). Destroying the resource does nothing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Restart the app whenever its config file changes.
resource "coolify_resource_action" "restart_web" {
  resource_type = "application"
  resource_uuid = coolify_application.web.uuid
  action        = "restart"

  triggers = {
    config_hash = sha1(coolify_storage.config.content)
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) `start`, `stop` or `restart`.
- `resource_type` (String) `application`, `database` or `service`.
- `resource_uuid` (String) UUID of the target resource.

### Optional

- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values; any change re-runs the action (e.g. `{ config_hash = sha1(...) }`).
